In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 1 466 308 000 and a loss of NOK 12 765 000, with positive equity of NOK 225 783 000.
It has a registered CEO, board chair and auditor, and its 2025 accounts were audited.
The most recent dated item found is "Meldepliktig avtale", published 2026-10-14 (Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer).
Watch-outs: net loss in the 2025 accounts.

conclusion.method: Each claim is built only from the listed facts; nothing is inferred beyond them.

summary: LYSE ENERGI AS (org. no. 980 335 224) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-12-17. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 35.150 (Handel med elektrisitet); it has 10 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 1 466 308 000 and net income was NOK -12 765 000. CEO: Ane Christophersen; board chair: Leiv Ingve Ørke; auditor: DELOITTE AS. Most recent dated item found (2026-10-14): "Meldepliktig avtale" – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 15 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links. Watch-outs: net loss in the 2025 accounts.

conclusion.text: ELVEPROMENADEN BORETTSLAG is an active housing cooperative in activities of households, based in Verdal. Its employee count is not registered, so its headcount is unknown. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 1 512 977 and a profit of NOK 443 313, with positive equity of NOK 4 280 401. It has a registered board chair and auditor, and its 2025 accounts were audited. The most recent dated item found is "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts), published 2026-05-23 (Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer). No risk flags were found in the registers checked (bankruptcy, liquidation, compulsory dissolution, negative equity, losses).

summary: ELVEPROMENADEN BORETTSLAG (org. no. 987 269 138) is a housing cooperative (BRL) based in Verdal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-09-27. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 1 512 977 and net income was NOK 443 313. Board chair: Geir Ove Sagvold; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS. Most recent dated item found (2026-05-23): "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts) – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 15 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links.

conclusion.text: FRISØRBUA AS is an active private limited company in other service activities, based in Bjørnafjorden. It has 5 registered employees and 1 registered establishments. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 28.920 (Produksjon av maskiner og utstyr til bergverksdrift og bygge- og anleggsvirksomhet); it has 19 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 37 737 996 and net income was NOK 1 549 419. No risk flags were found in the registers checked (bankruptcy, liquidation, compulsory dissolution).
